body: Lil Baby didn’t forget about this old BenDaDonn video 😭😂 While the two were linking up backstage, Baby brought up a video Ben posted over a year ago titled, “BenDaDonn PRESSES Lil Baby After his Friend Tried Scamming Him,” and jokingly told him he needed to change the clickbait title 😂 Ben immediately blamed his cameraman before later clarifying that there’s no real tension and they joke about the video all the time. Baby really held onto that title for an entire year 😭 Via/
